minor_findings.body_locator: §捌 方案一「原擬附加之...條件仍標示為 UNKNOWN‑sourced」；§玖 規則13「待補來源欄位可用 UNKNOWN-sourced 標示缺口」
minor_findings.evidence: The live complaint condition still uses a non-breaking hyphen U+2011 in 「UNKNOWN‑sourced」. The only plain ASCII 「UNKNOWN-sourced」 is a generic gate-rule phrase in §玖 13 and is not tied to that condition, so the original R06 searchability point is only partly addressed.
minor_findings.required_action: Add the same provenance once in ASCII next to the complaint condition, or state it once in §柒-二/§玖 with an explicit tie to that condition.

minor_findings.body_locator: §拾-一 標題「真實資料替換四步檢核流程（SAMPLE）」對照流程圖「步驟 1」至「步驟 5」
minor_findings.evidence: The heading and numbered prose describe four steps, but the flowchart displays five boxes and treats authorization as a separate step 5. Administrative readers may not know whether authorization is a distinct gate or part of validation.
minor_findings.required_action: Retitle as a five-step flow, or merge step 5 into step 4 and align the prose.

minor_findings.body_locator: 附錄四-2「方案二之 Q2 Top-2（目標 75%）」；§捌 方案二「Top-2 成功條件為嚴格大於 75.00%」
minor_findings.evidence: The formula sheet calls 75% the target, while the proposal says 9/12 = 75.00% fails and strictly more than 75% is required. 「目標 75%」 can be read as 75% being acceptable.
minor_findings.required_action: Change the formula-sheet wording to 「門檻 >75.00%；n=12 至少 10/12」.

minor_findings.body_locator: §捌 方案一「既有 3.8000 分為分析下限」；方案二「既有 3.7000 分為分析下限」
minor_findings.evidence: The report does not define what analysis these floors bound or derive them from the frozen data. They are retained legacy numbers and could still be mistaken for criteria despite being declared not to be improvement targets.
minor_findings.required_action: Define them explicitly as retired SAMPLE parameters or remove them, leaving baseline + 1/12 as the only proposed target.

checks.evidence: R06 minor 2 and 3 are resolved in the text. R06 minor 1 is not independently verifiable because the register text is absent; the R07 QA receipt's locator claims are builder metadata, not semantic proof. R06 minor 4 is only partly resolved, as noted in R07-M01.

prior_findings_disposition.R06_minor_1_register_locators: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIABLE — the sidecar register text is not in the packet. The R07 QA receipt claims 36 Chinese row locators and 44 rows bound to the exact manuscript SHA, but that receipt is not treated as semantic evidence.
prior_findings_disposition.R06_minor_2_core_vs_Q7: RESOLVED — §伍 and §參-三 now separate Q1–Q6 from Q7, and §陸-一 uses the Q1–Q6 six-item count.
prior_findings_disposition.R06_minor_3_thresholds: RESOLVED IN SUBSTANCE — Q2/Q5 baselines, baseline+1/12 hypothetical targets and the strict >75% Q2 Top-2 rule are published. Undefined legacy 3.8000/3.7000 floors remain a minor clarity issue.
prior_findings_disposition.R06_minor_4_ascii_provenance: PARTIAL — §捌 still uses U+2011 「UNKNOWN‑sourced」; ASCII 「UNKNOWN-sourced」 appears only as a generic gate-rule phrase in §玖 13, not at the live complaint condition.

limitations: No DOCX binary, OOXML structure, Word render, page image, chart pixel or PDF visual layer was inspected.
The sidecar replacement register was not supplied for text inspection; QA receipt metadata was not used as semantic proof.
No native provider/model metadata was available; actual model identity remains UNKNOWN.
Review used only the supplied extracted text and frozen rows; no external assumptions or real evidence were introduced.
